pattern: Demands refundable registration or onboarding deposit before issuing offer letter
example_text: Congratulations! You have been shortlisted for our Graduate Software Intern position. To confirm your slot and receive your appointment letter, please pay a refundable registration fee of INR 1,499 via UPI within 24 hours.

pattern: Requires candidate to purchase mandatory proprietary training material or kit
example_text: Selected candidates are required to purchase the mandatory technical training handbook and software kit for Rs 3,500. This amount will be reimbursed with your first month salary upon completion of 30 days.

pattern: Laptop security deposit or courier insurance fee charged before work-from-home dispatch
example_text: Company will courier an Apple MacBook Pro and home office kit. Please deposit a refundable security & transit insurance clearance charge of Rs 5,000 to our logistics partner account before dispatch.

pattern: High pressure countdown ultimatum demanding immediate fee payment or acceptance within hours
example_text: URGENT NOTICE: Only 2 interview slots remain for this recruitment cycle. You must accept this offer and complete onboarding formalities within 2 hours or your candidacy will be permanently cancelled.

pattern: Forced instantaneous payment to lock slot without allowing candidate time for verification
example_text: Offer expires strictly at 4:00 PM today. Pay the document processing charge immediately to guarantee your job seat.

pattern: Aggressive intimidation regarding blacklist from future campus recruitment
example_text: Failure to respond and remit the compliance verification charge within 60 minutes will result in your college being blacklisted from future corporate placement drives.

pattern: Recruiter claims affiliation with top tier tech firm but sends from public Gmail or Hotmail
example_text: We represent Microsoft Talent Acquisition India. Please send your updated resume and mark sheet to our senior hiring manager at hr.microsoftrecruitment.india@gmail.com.

pattern: Typosquatting or unofficial domain impersonating enterprise company name
example_text: Official letter from Google Cloud HR team. Reply directly to careers@google-hiring-portal-india.com to accept your offer.

pattern: Direct Telegram or WhatsApp only contact without official corporate email correspondence
example_text: Hi, I am hiring manager from Amazon HR. Your resume was selected on Naukri. Connect immediately with our hiring head on Telegram @AmazonJobsIndiaDesk for instant offer letter.

pattern: Exorbitant salary for simple part-time or entry-level data entry / copy-paste role
example_text: Urgent hiring! Work from home 2 hours daily doing simple form filling and data entry. Guaranteed salary of INR 75,000 per month plus daily bonus. No experience required.

pattern: Unrealistically high fresher package without technical assessment or formal interview
example_text: Congratulations on your direct campus selection as Junior Analyst! Starting annual CTC: INR 36,00,000 (36 LPA) without interview or coding assessment.

pattern: Huge daily crypto or commission payouts promised for basic social media liking/review tasks
example_text: Earn Rs 5,000 to Rs 15,000 per day simply subscribing to YouTube channels and reviewing Google maps locations. Instant payout to your UPI wallet.

pattern: Demands bank account details, UPI PIN, or internet banking login before any formal interview
example_text: For salary credit account setup, send your bank account number, IFSC code, registered mobile number, and net banking password/OTP verification.

pattern: Requests unredacted government IDs (Aadhaar, PAN, Passport) and debit card photos upfront
example_text: Submit clear photographs of your Aadhaar card front and back, PAN card, and front photo of debit card to confirm identity before scheduling Round 1.

pattern: Demands original educational mark sheets or certificates to be mailed to unknown address
example_text: Candidates must courier their original 10th, 12th, and Degree mark sheets to our verification office for physical retention during the 6-month probation period.

pattern: Instant job selection letter issued without any interview, screening, or application submitted
example_text: Direct Selection Notice: Your profile was selected from our national candidate database for Associate Executive. No interview needed. Appointment letter attached.

pattern: Zero job responsibilities, skills, or job description mentioned in offer communication
example_text: Join our global project team immediately. Role details and duties will be assigned after joining. Flexible hours, unlimited incentives, no skills required.

pattern: Informal interview conducted entirely via text messages on WhatsApp or Telegram with immediate offer
example_text: Based on our 5-minute chat on WhatsApp, our board of directors is pleased to offer you the position of Assistant Manager. Please sign and return today.
